शृध् शृध्, cl. 1. A. (also P. in Fut.,
Aor., Cond.) शर्धते, शशृधे, शर्-
धिष्यते (and शर्त्स्यति), अशृधत्, &c., शर्धि-
तुम्, to break wind downwards; cl. 1. P. A. शर्-
धति, -ते, to moisten, become moist or wet; cl.
10. P. शर्धयति, to insult (by breaking wind
against or by voiding excrement), mock at, ridicule;
to strive, make effort, (in this sense also cl. 1. P.
according to some): Caus. शर्धयति, -यितुम्:
Desid. शिशर्धिषते, शिशृत्सति: Intens. शरीशृ-
ध्यते, शरीशर्द्धि.

शृधु, उस्, m. f. (according to Śabda-k. only
m.), the anus; = बुद्धि.

शृधू, ऊस्, m. f. (according to Śabda-k. only
m.), the anus; = कुत्सित.

शृध्या, f., Ved. effort, success, (Sāy. = उत्साह-
नीयं कर्म, Ṛg-veda
